name: Dobroe utro, mir!
source:
"When was the last time you thought about sanity? A year ago? Today? Never?
Some people think about it every day. Waking up in the middle of the night, he hears strange noises.
Brushing his teeth, he notices something in the mirror. Eating breakfast, he tastes nothing but spoiled food.
Are you sure this is reality?
Have you lost your mind?
Do you have all the answers?
Maybe today you will finally figure out the truth."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“你最后一次思考理智是什么时候？一年前？今天？从来没有？
有些人每天都在思考这个问题。半夜醒来，他听到奇怪的声音。
刷牙的时候，他注意到镜子里有什么东西。吃早餐时，他只尝到变质的食物。
你确定这是现实吗？
你失去理智了吗？
你有所有的答案吗？
也许今天你终于会明白真相了。”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271580/]Steam[/url]]
